applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations (5 pads on site)
findings.comment: Transformer pads are shown on Sheets 21 and 9 adjacent to building exterior walls (west of Bldg. 2, west of Bldg. 8, between Bldg. 4-5, between Bldg. 6-7), but no horizontal clearance dimensions are provided to verify minimum 5-foot separation from buildings.

applicableAreas: Retaining wall areas (NW corner and perimeter locations)
findings.comment: Retaining walls are shown on Sheets 38-39 and grading plan, and transformer pads are shown on Sheet 21, but clearance dimensions between retaining walls and transformer pads are not documented.

applicableAreas: Fence areas adjacent to transformer locations
findings.comment: Fences (H.6) are shown on landscape plan and site perimeter. Transformer access door orientation and clearances from removable ventilated fences (5 feet for operator sides, 3 feet for other sides) are not documented.

applicableAreas: Sidewalk areas near transformer pads
findings.comment: Sidewalks are shown on the site plan and electrical plan sheets, but the minimum 2-foot clearance from back of sidewalk to transformer pad edge is not dimensionally verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad hot-stick use areas (5 pads)
findings.comment: Transformer pads are shown on Sheet 21, but access door orientation and the minimum 10-foot clearance for hot-stick use area to open area or adjacent building/structure are not documented.

applicableAreas: Fire hydrant area relative to transformer pads
findings.comment: One private fire hydrant is shown on Sheet 10 (Fire Protection Plan), but dimensional clearance from the hydrant to the nearest transformer pad is not documented.

applicableAreas: Landscape planting areas near transformer locations
findings.comment: Landscape plan (Sheet 31) shows trees on site, but the specific distances from each tree to transformer pads are not documented, and utility-compatible species verification per ECM Appendix F is not provided.

applicableAreas: Landscape shrub and vegetation areas near transformers
findings.comment: Landscape plan shows shrubs and groundcover (H.7 SOD areas), but clearance distances from transformer access doors (10 lateral feet minimum) and other sides (5 lateral feet minimum) are not documented.

applicableAreas: Trees within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment
findings.comment: Tree locations are shown on landscape plan, but distances from trees to underground electric transformer locations are not documented, and root barrier specifications (4 feet deep, 5 feet from equipment) are not provided.

applicableAreas: Bicycle parking areas near transformer pads
findings.comment: Site provides 41 bicycle parking spaces per Sheet 22, but specific bike rack locations relative to transformer pads and the minimum 5-foot clearance are not documented.

applicableAreas: Fire lanes adjacent to transformer pads
findings.comment: Fire lanes are shown on Sheet 10, but the minimum 15-foot clearance from transformer pads to fire lanes is not dimensionally verified.

applicableAreas: Multiple transformer pad locations (5 pads on site)
findings.comment: Five transformer pads are shown on Sheet 21, but minimum 5-foot clearance distances between pads are not documented.

applicableAreas: Water line routing relative to transformer pads
findings.comment: Water lines are shown on Sheet 19 (Utility Tap Plan) and electrical plan shows transformer locations, but minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance between water lines and transformer pads is not dimensionally verified.

applicableAreas: Wastewater line routing relative to transformer pads
findings.comment: Wastewater lines are shown on Sheet 19 and transformer locations on Sheet 21, but minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance between wastewater lines and transformer pads is not documented.

applicableAreas: Storm drain line routing relative to transformer pads
findings.comment: Storm drain lines are shown on Sheet 12 and transformer locations on Sheet 21, but minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance between storm lines and transformer pads is not documented.

applicableAreas: Underground utility locations near transformer pads
findings.comment: Multiple underground utilities are shown on utility plans and transformer locations on Sheet 21, but minimum 12-inch horizontal and vertical clearance from other underground utilities (except gas, fuel, steam) is not dimensionally verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer locations and underground utility paths
findings.comment: Transformer pad locations and underground utility paths are shown, but no analysis is provided to verify that transformer pads or AE underground facilities are not located over or under other utility lines.

applicableAreas: Access paths to transformer pads with overhead structures
findings.comment: Transformer pad locations are shown on Sheet 21 near buildings and parking areas, but cross-section drawings demonstrating vertical clearances in access paths with overhead structures or parking garages are not provided.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations (5 pads)
findings.comment: Transformer pads are shown on site plan, but their exact positioning relative to property lines is not dimensionally documented to verify 100% location on private property.

applicableAreas: Transformer locations relative to existing easements
findings.comment: Multiple easements exist on site (wastewater 10', drainage 25', drainage 10', electric 5' per recorded plats), but no analysis is provided to verify transformer pads are not located in prohibited easements (drainage, water, sewer, or electric easements under overhead lines).

applicableAreas: All five transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Transformer easements are not shown around any of the five transformer pads on the site plan, electrical plan, or plat. UCM § 1.10.3 requires transformer easements for Austin Energy accessibility and maintenance.

applicableAreas: Electrical routing from transformers to meters
findings.comment: Electrical routing is shown on Sheet 21, but the path of electric service from each transformer to associated meters is not dimensionally verified as 100% on private property.

applicableAreas: All five transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Transformer pad dimensions are not provided on any sheet for any of the five pads shown. No reference to Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets is provided. Exact pad dimensions matching AE Design specifications for the specified service type are required.

applicableAreas: Transformer pads within 4 feet of parking areas
findings.comment: Transformer locations and parking areas are shown on site plan, but documentation of which transformer pads (if any) are within 4 feet of parking/vehicle routes and bollard specifications (4-inch minimum diameter galvanized metal posts per AE Design details) are not provided.
